entities.name: Northern Landscape style
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The northern landscape style was a manner of Chinese landscape painting centered on a loose group of artists who worked and lived in Northern China during the Five Dynasties period that occupied the time between the collapse of the Tang dynasty and the rise of the Song. The style stands in opposition to the Southern School of Chinese painting.
